Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pSVar11` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on its own `motion_name` field (which decays to a pointer), `+ CONST`; `offsetof(motion_name) + CONST*sizeof(elem)` equals the stride of a *different* array the loop reads through `pSVar11`. Replace those `pSVar11->other_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update. (String/buffer-copy cursors that only touch the advanced field are excluded here — those are unrolled_strcpy/unrolled_memcpy.)
